chunks: And one of his (peace be upon him) oaths: he wrote it between Rabī'ah and Yemen. Translated from the writing of Hishām ibn al-Kalbī.

key_terms.الْيَمَنِ: Yemen, referring to the people or region of Yemen
key_terms.حَلَفَ: He swore / He made an oath
key_terms.هِشَامُ بْنُ الْكَلْبِيِّ: Hishām ibn al-Kalbī, a known historian and narrator

ai.seo_question: What was the content of Imam Ali's oath regarding the treaty between Rabī'ah and Yemen?
ai.summary: This concise narration highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) diplomatic engagement with the southern Arabian tribes, specifically the Rabī'ah and Yemeni groups, reflecting his efforts to consolidate political and tribal alliances during his caliphate. The attribution to the handwriting of the renowned historian Hishām ibn al-Kalbī underscores the early preservation of this record within scholarly circles, lending it credibility as a primary source for understanding the administrative protocols of the early Islamic state.
